_about: T-086 M4 exit: the money scenarios of docs/spec/fixtures/money-scenarios.md (M4 domain behaviour of 1–9, 11–13, 15–19 with sub-parts and PKP variants; the facts of 10 and 14), the M4 PRD §8 scenarios (incl. the M0–M3 deferrals that complete in M4), the M4 CLIN ids and the PLAN.md M4 items, mapped to the exact test cases that prove each (JUnit classname = file, name = 'describe > test'). Checked by check-scenarios.py against a JUnit report of `pnpm test -- money`. 'proves' states what the cases assert (rupiah where they assert it; some tests use other illustrative prices than the fixture, see README); 'open' what M4 does not prove and where it completes.
